banner.title: surrealdb
banner.tagline: A single-writer SurrealDB on RocksDB, with a logical export taken inside every kopiur snapshot.

explainer.title: One writer, one export, two snapshot copies

steps.title: Login
steps.text: ExternalSecret surrealdb-secret pulls the root user and password from 1Password item surrealdb. The pod reads them as SURREAL_USER and SURREAL_PASS.
steps.scene: a key turning in a vault door

steps.title: Store
steps.text: One replica writes RocksDB under /data on a 20Gi ceph-block claim. The Recreate strategy detaches the old pod before the new one mounts the volume.
steps.scene: one data cylinder with a single arrow writing into it

steps.title: Export
steps.text: Before each snapshot, kopiur runs surreal export inside the pod for the production database in the open_notebook namespace. A failed export fails the whole snapshot.
steps.scene: a dump file drawn out of a stack of database discs

steps.title: Snapshot
steps.text: kopiur writes the snapshot to Ceph on its own schedule and to the R2 bucket on a second, daily schedule.
steps.scene: two archive boxes joined by a cyan data path

steps.title: Route
steps.text: HTTPRoute serves the API on envoy-internal. Gatus checks /health, because the bare root redirects to a third-party site.
steps.scene: a gateway arch with one path leading to a node

art.about: a single-writer database backed up by a logical export inside each snapshot
art.title: How SurrealDB is backed up
